bodyReviews.observedPublisherContent: Describes standard recurrence and distinguishes repeating events from tasks that surface the next incomplete occurrence.

bodyReviews.readScope: Complete main body, lines 57–130 across two views.

bodyReviews.limits: Page carries a June 2016 update date despite some modern wording. Reverify provider behavior and current settings in current primary provider documentation.

bodyReviews.readScope: Complete substantive FAQ lines 14–123; changelog lines 126–249 also displayed and reviewed.

bodyReviews.limits: Its global calendar-set behavior and refresh suggestions are competitor-specific; no refresh-time guarantee for Cloud.
